name: Oggiono (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of blue and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Oggiono (an eagle, clasped hands with the date MDCLIV, and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Oggiono, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were granted by decree of the President of the Republic in 2017.

features.role: Oggiono arms — eagle, clasped hands with the date MDCLIV and waves, crowned
